text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents original research focused on predicting future land use change (LUC) hot-spots across the entire country of Italy to the year 2100 using an ensemble of 32 simulations. The methodology uses a 500-m grid covering all of Italy, includes spatially explicit LULC projections mapped at multiple administrative and biogeographical scales, and reports quantitative metrics such as stability factors, ROC/AUC validation (average accuracy 0.86), and percent change rates in hot-spot areas.
